findings.description: The security group permits TCP/22 from 0.0.0.0/0. Because the instance is placed in a public subnet and receives a public IP, this exposes SSH to arbitrary Internet hosts.

The user-data script embeds an AWS access key ID and secret access key. Credentials stored in Terraform source and instance user data can be exposed through source control, Terraform state, EC2 metadata/user-data access, or host compromise.

The EBS volume does not set encrypted = true or a KMS key. The attached disk may therefore store data unencrypted at rest unless account-level default encryption is relied upon outside this configuration.
This snapshot is created from an EBS volume that is not configured for encryption. It can therefore contain the volume's data without encryption at rest.

The bucket used as the VPC flow-log archive has no server-side encryption configuration. Sensitive network telemetry written to it is not protected at rest by an encryption setting in this Terraform configuration.
